DIV5.HEAD: PART 165—REGULATED NAVIGATION AREAS AND LIMITED ACCESS AREAS

DIV8.HEAD: § 165.5 Definitions.
DIV8.P: For the purposes of this part:
Designated representative means any Coast Guard commissioned, warrant, or petty officer designated by the District Commander or the Captain of the Port to act on his or her behalf.
Regulated navigation area (RNA) means a water area within a defined boundary for which regulations for vessels navigating within the area have been established under this part.

DIV8.HEAD: § 165.13 General regulations.
DIV8.P: (a) The master of a vessel in a regulated navigation area shall operate the vessel in accordance with the regulations established for that area.
(b) No vessel may anchor in a regulated navigation area unless the District Commander or a designated representative authorizes it.

DIV6.HEAD: Subpart F—Specific Regulated Navigation Areas and Limited Access Areas

DIV8.HEAD: § 165.T01 Safety Zone; Harbor Fireworks, Bristol, RI.
DIV8.P: (a) Location. The following area is a safety zone: all navigable waters within 500 yards of the fireworks barge in Bristol Harbor.
(b) Definitions. As used in this section, designated representative means a Coast Guard Patrol Commander or any Coast Guard officer designated by the Captain of the Port Southeastern New England.
(c) Regulations. No vessel may enter the safety zone unless authorized by the Captain of the Port or a designated representative.
